+class Entry:
+    def __init__(self, path, name=None, parent=None, synthetic=False):
+        self.path = Path(path)
+        self.name = name if name is not None else self.path.name or str(self.path)
+        self.parent = parent
+        self.synthetic = synthetic
+        self._lstat = None
+        self._stat = None

+    def lstat(self):
+        if self.synthetic:
+            return os.stat_result((stat.S_IFDIR, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, time.time(), time.time(), time.time()))
+        if self._lstat is None:
+            self._lstat = os.lstat(self.path)
+        return self._lstat
+
+    def stat(self, follow=False):
+        if self.synthetic:
+            return self.lstat()
+        if follow:
+            if self._stat is None:
+                self._stat = os.stat(self.path)
+            return self._stat
+        return self.lstat()
+
+    def is_link(self):
+        return (not self.synthetic) and os.path.islink(self.path)
+
+    def is_dir(self, follow=False):
+        try:
+            if self.synthetic:
+                return True
+            return self.path.is_dir() if follow else stat.S_ISDIR(self.lstat().st_mode)
+        except OSError:
+            return False
+
+    def is_file(self, follow=False):
+        try:
+            return stat.S_ISREG(self.stat(follow).st_mode)
+        except OSError:
+            return False
+
+    def ext(self):
+        n = self.name
+        if n in (".", ".."):
+            return ""

+def parse_args(argv):
+    flags = []
+    files = []
+    i = 0
+    end_options = False
+    while i < len(argv):
+        arg = argv[i]
+        if end_options or arg == "-" or not arg.startswith("-"):
+            files.append(arg)
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if arg == "--":
+            end_options = True
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        if arg.startswith("--"):
+            raw = arg[2:]
+            if "=" in raw:
+                name, value = raw.split("=", 1)
+                had_eq = True
+            else:
+                name, value, had_eq = raw, None, False
+            if name not in LONG_FLAGS:
+                raise CliError(f"Unknown argument --{name}.")
+            _, takes, choices, default = LONG_FLAGS[name]
+            if takes == "forbidden":
+                if had_eq:
+                    raise CliError(f"Option --{name} doesn't allow an argument.")
+                flags.append((name, NO_VALUE))
+            elif takes == "necessary":
+                if value is None:
+                    i += 1
+                    if i >= len(argv):
+                        raise CliError(f"Option --{name} needs a value.")
+                    value = argv[i]
+                if choices is not None and not (name == "time-style" and value.startswith("+")) and value not in choices:
+                    raise CliError(f"Invalid value '{value}' for option --{name}.")
+                flags.append((name, value))
+            else:
+                if value is None:
+                    if i + 1 < len(argv) and argv[i + 1] in choices:
+                        i += 1
+                        value = argv[i]
+                    else:
+                        value = default
+                elif choices is not None and value not in choices:
+                    raise CliError(f"Invalid value '{value}' for option --{name}.")
+                flags.append((name, value))
+            i += 1
+            continue
+        j = 1
+        while j < len(arg):
+            ch = arg[j]
+            if ch not in SHORT_TO_LONG:
+                raise CliError(f"Unknown argument -{ch}.")
+            name = SHORT_TO_LONG[ch]
+            _, takes, choices, default = LONG_FLAGS[name]
+            rest = arg[j + 1:]
+            if takes == "forbidden":
+                flags.append((name, NO_VALUE))
+                j += 1
+                continue
+            if takes == "necessary":
+                if rest.startswith("="):
+                    rest = rest[1:]
+                if rest:
+                    value = rest
+                    j = len(arg)
+                else:
+                    i += 1
+                    if i >= len(argv):
+                        raise CliError(f"Option -{ch} needs a value.")
+                    value = argv[i]
+                    j = len(arg)
+                if choices is not None and value not in choices:
+                    raise CliError(f"Invalid value '{value}' for option -{ch}.")
+                flags.append((name, value))
+                continue
+            if rest:
+                value = rest[1:] if rest.startswith("=") else rest
+                if choices is not None and value not in choices:
+                    raise CliError(f"Invalid value '{value}' for option -{ch}.")
+                flags.append((name, value))
+                j = len(arg)
+            else:
+                if i + 1 < len(argv) and argv[i + 1] in choices:
+                    i += 1
+                    value = argv[i]
+                else:
+                    value = default
+                flags.append((name, value))
+                j = len(arg)
+        i += 1
+    return flags, files

+def has(flags, name):
+    return any(k == name for k, _ in flags)

+def count(flags, name):
+    return sum(1 for k, _ in flags if k == name)

+def get(flags, name, default=None):
+    for k, v in reversed(flags):
+        if k == name:
+            return v
+    return default

+def options(flags):
+    width = get(flags, "width", None)
+    if width is not None:

+            width = int(width)

+            raise CliError(f"Invalid number '{width}' for option --width.") from exc
+    level = get(flags, "level", None)
+    if level is not None:
+        try:
+            level = int(level)
+        except ValueError as exc:
+            raise CliError(f"Invalid number '{level}' for option --level.") from exc
+    return {
+        "long": has(flags, "long"),
+        "grid": has(flags, "grid"),
+        "oneline": has(flags, "oneline") or has(flags, "long") or has(flags, "tree"),
+        "tree": has(flags, "tree"),
+        "recurse": has(flags, "recurse") or has(flags, "tree"),
+        "across": has(flags, "across"),
+        "classify": get(flags, "classify", "never"),
+        "icons": get(flags, "icons", "never"),
+        "color": get(flags, "color", get(flags, "colour", "auto")),
+        "absolute": get(flags, "absolute", "off"),
+        "follow_symlinks": has(flags, "follow-symlinks"),
+        "deref": has(flags, "dereference"),

+        "only_dirs": has(flags, "only-dirs"),
+        "only_files": has(flags, "only-files"),
+        "no_symlinks": has(flags, "no-symlinks"),
+        "show_symlinks": has(flags, "show-symlinks"),
+        "level": level,
+        "reverse": has(flags, "reverse"),
+        "sort": get(flags, "sort", "name"),
+        "dirs_first": has(flags, "group-directories-first"),
+        "dirs_last": has(flags, "group-directories-last"),

+        "binary": has(flags, "binary"),

+def get_all(flags, name):
+    return [v for k, v in flags if k == name]

+    if has(flags, "accessed"):
+        return "accessed"
+    if has(flags, "created"):
+        return "created"

+def include_entry(e, opt):
+    name = e.name
+    if name.startswith(".") and opt["all_count"] == 0 and not opt["almost_all"]:
+        return False
+    for patset in opt["ignore"]:
+        for pat in patset.split("|"):
+            if pat and fnmatch.fnmatch(name, pat):
+                return False
+    is_link = e.is_link()
+    is_dir = e.is_dir(False)
+    is_file = e.is_file(False)
+    if opt["no_symlinks"] and is_link:
+        return False
+    if opt["only_dirs"]:
+        return is_dir or (opt["show_symlinks"] and is_link and e.is_dir(True))
+    if opt["only_files"]:
+        return is_file or (opt["show_symlinks"] and is_link and e.is_file(True))
+    return True

+def read_dir(path, opt):
+    entries = []
+    if opt["all_count"] >= 2:
+        entries.append(Entry(Path(path) / ".", ".", path, True))
+        entries.append(Entry(Path(path) / "..", "..", path, True))
+    try:
+        with os.scandir(path) as it:
+            for de in it:
+                entries.append(Entry(de.path, de.name, path))
+    except OSError:
+        raise
+    entries = [e for e in entries if include_entry(e, opt)]
+    sort_entries(entries, opt)
+    return entries

+def sort_entries(entries, opt):
+    field = opt["sort"]
+    if field == "none":
+        return
+    def key(e):
+        try:
+            st = e.stat(opt["deref"])
+        except OSError:
+            st = None
+        n = e.name
+        lname = n.lower()
+        hidden_prefix = n.startswith(".")
+        if field in ("Name", "Filename"):
+            base = n
+        elif field in (".name", ".filename"):
+            base = (lname.lstrip("."), lname)
+        elif field in (".Name", ".Filename"):
+            base = (n.lstrip("."), n)
+        elif field in ("size", "filesize"):
+            base = st.st_size if st else 0
+        elif field in ("ext", "extension"):
+            base = (e.ext(), lname)
+        elif field in ("Ext", "Extension"):
+            base = (e.ext(), n)
+        elif field in ("date", "time", "mod", "modified", "new", "newest"):
+            base = -(st.st_mtime if st else 0)
+        elif field in ("age", "old", "oldest"):
+            base = st.st_mtime if st else 0
+        elif field in ("acc", "accessed"):
+            base = -(st.st_atime if st else 0)
+        elif field in ("cr", "created", "ch", "changed"):
+            base = -(st.st_ctime if st else 0)
+        elif field == "inode":
+            base = st.st_ino if st else 0
+        elif field == "type":
+            base = (type_rank(e), lname)
+        else:
+            base = (hidden_prefix, lname)
+        group = 1
+        if opt["dirs_first"] and e.is_dir(False):
+            group = 0
+        elif opt["dirs_last"] and e.is_dir(False):
+            group = 2
+        return (group, base)
+    entries.sort(key=key, reverse=opt["reverse"])
+
+
+def type_rank(e):
+    if e.is_dir(False):
+        return 0
+    if e.is_link():
+        return 1
+    return 2

+def display_path(e, opt):
+    if opt["absolute"] == "on":
+        return os.path.abspath(e.path)
+    if opt["absolute"] == "follow":
+        return os.path.realpath(e.path)
+    return e.name

+def link_suffix(e):
+    if e.is_link():
+        try:
+            return " -> " + os.readlink(e.path)
+        except OSError:
+            return ""
+    return ""

+
+def classify_suffix(e, opt):
+    if opt["classify"] == "never":
+        return ""
+    if e.is_dir(False):
+        return "/"
+    mode = 0
+    try:
+        mode = e.lstat().st_mode
+    except OSError:
+        pass
+    if e.is_link():
+        return "@"
+    if mode & stat.S_IXUSR:
+        return "*"
+    return ""

+def icon_prefix(e, opt):
+    if opt["icons"] == "never" or opt["icons"] == "auto":
+        return ""
+    if e.is_dir(False):
+        return "\ue5ff "
+    ext = e.ext()
+    if ext in ("png", "jpg", "jpeg", "gif", "bmp", "webp"):
+        return "\uf1c5 "
+    if ext == "svg":
+        return "\U000f0559 "
+    return "\U000f086f "

+def colorize(text, e, opt):
+    if opt["color"] != "always":
+        return text
+    if e.is_dir(False):
+        return "\x1b[1;34m" + text + "\x1b[0m"
+    if e.is_link():
+        return "\x1b[36m" + text + "\x1b[0m"
+    return text

+def name_cell(e, opt, tree_prefix=""):
+    text = display_path(e, opt) + link_suffix(e) + classify_suffix(e, opt)
+    text = icon_prefix(e, opt) + text
+    text = colorize(text, e, opt)
+    return tree_prefix + text

+def perm_string(e, opt):
+    try:
+        m = e.lstat().st_mode
+    except OSError:
+        return "-----" if os.name == "nt" else "??????????"
+    if opt["octal"]:
+        return format(stat.S_IMODE(m), "04o")
+    if os.name == "nt":
+        if stat.S_ISDIR(m):
+            lead = "d"
+        elif stat.S_ISLNK(m):
+            lead = "l"
+        else:
+            lead = "-"
+        readonly = "r" if not (m & stat.S_IWRITE) else "a"
+        return lead + readonly + "---"
+    lead = "d" if stat.S_ISDIR(m) else "l" if stat.S_ISLNK(m) else "-"
+    bits = ""
+    for who in ((stat.S_IRUSR, stat.S_IWUSR, stat.S_IXUSR), (stat.S_IRGRP, stat.S_IWGRP, stat.S_IXGRP), (stat.S_IROTH, stat.S_IWOTH, stat.S_IXOTH)):
+        bits += "r" if m & who[0] else "-"
+        bits += "w" if m & who[1] else "-"
+        bits += "x" if m & who[2] else "-"
+    return lead + bits

+def size_value(e, opt):
+    try:
+        st = e.stat(opt["deref"])
+    except OSError:
+        return "-"
+    if e.is_dir(False):
+        return "-"
+    size = st.st_size
+    if opt["blocksize"]:
+        return str(getattr(st, "st_blocks", 0))
+    if opt["bytes"]:
+        return str(size)
+    base = 1024 if opt["binary"] else 1000
+    units = ["", "K", "M", "G", "T"] if not opt["binary"] else ["", "Ki", "Mi", "Gi", "Ti"]
+    n = float(size)
+    idx = 0
+    while n >= base and idx < len(units) - 1:
+        n /= base
+        idx += 1
+    if idx == 0:
+        return str(size)
+    return f"{n:.1f}{units[idx]}"
+

+def time_value(e, opt):
+    try:
+        st = e.stat(opt["deref"])
+    except OSError:
+        return "-"
+    ts = st.st_mtime
+    if opt["time_field"] == "accessed":
+        ts = st.st_atime
+    elif opt["time_field"] in ("created", "changed"):
+        ts = st.st_ctime
+    lt = time.localtime(ts)
+    style = opt["time_style"]
+    if style.startswith("+"):
+        body = style[1:]
+        if body.count("\n") > 1 or body == "" or body == "\n":
+            raise RuntimeError("invalid custom time format")
+        fmt = body.split("\n", 1)[0]
+        return time.strftime(fmt, lt)
+    if style == "iso":
+        return time.strftime("%m-%d %H:%M" if lt.tm_year == time.localtime().tm_year else "%Y-%m-%d", lt)
+    if style == "long-iso":
+        return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M", lt)
+    if style == "full-iso":
+        return time.strftime("%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S.000000000 %z", lt)
+    if style == "relative":
+        delta = max(0, int(time.time() - ts))
+        if delta < 60:
+            return "now"
+        if delta < 3600:
+            return f"{delta // 60}m"
+        if delta < 86400:
+            return f"{delta // 3600}h"
+        return f"{delta // 86400}d"
+    mon = ["Jan", "Feb", "Mar", "Apr", "May", "Jun", "Jul", "Aug", "Sep", "Oct", "Nov", "Dec"][lt.tm_mon - 1]
+    if lt.tm_year == time.localtime().tm_year:
+        return f"{lt.tm_mday:2d} {mon:<3} {lt.tm_hour:02d}:{lt.tm_min:02d}"
+    return f"{lt.tm_mday:2d} {mon:<3}  {lt.tm_year}"
+

+def long_row(e, opt, tree_prefix=""):
+    cells = []
+    if opt["inode"]:
+        try:
+            cells.append(str(e.lstat().st_ino))
+        except OSError:
+            cells.append("-")
+    if not opt["no_permissions"]:
+        cells.append(perm_string(e, opt))
+    if opt["links"]:
+        try:
+            cells.append(str(e.lstat().st_nlink))
+        except OSError:
+            cells.append("-")
+    if not opt["no_filesize"]:
+        cells.append(size_value(e, opt))
+    if not opt["no_user"]:
+        cells.append(str(os.getuid()) if hasattr(os, "getuid") and opt["numeric"] else "")
+    if opt["group"]:
+        cells.append(str(os.getgid()) if hasattr(os, "getgid") and opt["numeric"] else "")
+    if not opt["no_time"]:
+        cells.append(time_value(e, opt))
+    cells = [c for c in cells if c != ""]
+    return (" ".join(cells) + (" " if cells else "") + name_cell(e, opt, tree_prefix))
+

+def render_entries(entries, opt):
+    if opt["long"]:
+        rows = []
+        if opt["header"]:
+            hdr = []
+            if opt["inode"]:
+                hdr.append("inode")
+            if not opt["no_permissions"]:
+                hdr.append("permissions")
+            if opt["links"]:
+                hdr.append("links")
+            if not opt["no_filesize"]:
+                hdr.append("size")
+            if not opt["no_user"]:
+                hdr.append("user")
+            if opt["group"]:
+                hdr.append("group")
+            if not opt["no_time"]:
+                hdr.append("date")
+            hdr.append("name")
+            rows.append(" ".join(hdr))
+        rows.extend(long_row(e, opt) for e in entries)
+        return rows
+    return [name_cell(e, opt) for e in entries]

+def print_lines(lines):
+    if lines:
+        sys.stdout.write("\n".join(lines) + "\n")

+def collect_arg_entries(files, opt):
+    entries = []
+    had_error = False
+    for f in files:
+        p = Path(f)
+        try:
+            os.lstat(p)
+        except OSError as e:
+            sys.stderr.write(f"\"{f}\": {e.strerror} (os error {getattr(e, 'winerror', e.errno) or e.errno})\n")
+            had_error = True
+            continue
+        entries.append(Entry(p, p.name or str(p), None))
+    return entries, had_error

+def render_nonrecursive(files, opt):
+    entries, had_error = collect_arg_entries(files, opt)
+    files_to_show = []
+    dirs_to_list = []
+    for e in entries:
+        if e.is_dir(False) and not opt["treat_dirs"] and len(files) == 1:
+            dirs_to_list.append(e)
+        elif e.is_dir(False) and not opt["treat_dirs"]:
+            dirs_to_list.append(e)
+        else:
+            if include_entry(e, opt):
+                files_to_show.append(e)
+    sort_entries(files_to_show, opt)
+    if files_to_show:
+        print_lines(render_entries(files_to_show, opt))
+    first_block = not bool(files_to_show)
+    for d in dirs_to_list:
+        try:
+            kids = read_dir(d.path, opt)
+        except OSError as e:
+            sys.stderr.write(f"\"{d.path}\": {e.strerror} (os error {getattr(e, 'winerror', e.errno) or e.errno})\n")
+            had_error = True
+            continue
+        if not first_block:
+            sys.stdout.write("\n")
+        if len(files) > 1:
+            sys.stdout.write(str(d.path) + ":\n")
+        print_lines(render_entries(kids, opt))
+        first_block = False
+    return 2 if had_error else 0
